en.title: aifc.kz: the Fees Rules page does not link Amendments No. 12 (1 May 2022)
en.summary: The list of amending instruments on the Fees Rules page goes from A11 to A13. Amendments No. 12 (approved 24 April 2022, in force 1 May 2022), which introduced the annual supervision fees, late fees and FinTech Lab fees, is in the site's media library but is not linked from the page.
en.correction: Add the link to Amendments No. 12 to the list on the Fees Rules page.
